mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seat_allocation_task (order_no, user_id, session_id, area_id, ticket_type, quantity, status, allocated_seats, fail_reason) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{areaId}, #{ticketType}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{allocatedSeats}, #{failReason})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, session_id, area_id, ticket_type, quantity, status, allocated_seats, fail_reason, create_time, update_time FROM seat_allocation_task WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE seat_allocation_task SET status = #{expectTo}, allocated_seats = COALESCE(#{allocatedSeats}, allocated_seats), fail_reason = COALESCE(#{failReason}, fail_reason) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = #{expectFrom}
